title: Phi3 = E8 + F5 Decomposition
interpretation: The parent K12/F12 CSS code exposes the Phi3=13 mixing sector. Gauge refinement splits it into an E8-rank logical sector plus five Fibonacci/gauge-clock qudits.
r1_interface: R1 should be attacked as a canonical integral lift/gauge-fixing problem on the 8 logical qudits of the subsystem, not as an eigenlattice search inside the +2 eigenspace already ruled out by BT926.

r2_r3_interfaces.R2: moonshine quintic should act on the 5 gauge-clock qudits or their phase transport, not on the 8 protected E8 logicals alone
r2_r3_interfaces.R3: continuum/EH coefficient should be extracted from the decoder/noise action of the 8+5 split, not from the raw finite graph alone

boundary: Structural decomposition and frontier-routing theorem only; not an integral E8 lift proof, moonshine module construction, or continuum coefficient derivation.
